title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #4): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from JetBrains client-wire drift, the proxy, and CONFIGURATION/ARCHITECTURE/SCHEMA docs drift
description:
Filed by the governor at 16:50Z on 2026-11-03. Hunts #2 (task-2597ac6f) and #3 (task-859eff80) produced 12 rows today, and 8 are already DONE. A notification-only architect session can't run a hunt, so the hunt is a claimable row.

WHY. Once the current plans are submitted, the PLANNING queue runs dry again, and about 5 coders are idle. The CQ-M07 wrapper chain stays serial. Quota is fine: acct-1 and acct-3 reset at 16:30Z.

LANE. Search, in this order of preference:
1. moe-jetbrains/src, the primary IDE. Look for client-wire drift against the daemon beyond what hunt #2 fixed (37e03b91 amendments, 40813cc1 worktreeMode, ac587df5 handoff fields, e44a8daf previous-arrow):
   - task, epic, worker, attempt or proposal fields the plugin parses under a stale name, or never parses although a dialog shows the concept;
   - /ws message types it never handles;
   - board moves it cannot express. One candidate, unverified: BoardMoves.kt moves task cards with next/previous arrows, and only epics are draggable. So a review the blocked-timeout sweep parked in BACKLOG may have no way back to REVIEW from the JetBrains board, even though /ws now accepts BACKLOG to REVIEW (task-6a818a1c). File it only if it's real.
2. packages/moe-proxy/src.
3. docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/SCHEMA.md against the code: a documented default, field, refusal code or env var that the code doesn't implement, or the reverse. The source of truth for defaults is packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts and state/validators.ts.

Skip:
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (task-85529f6c and task-e3d41183 hold sections of it) and moe-vscode/**;
- scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight* and scripts/tests/parity-check.*;
- every file an open row's plan holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.
Already known, so don't re-file: TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line, and the JetBrains board fingerprint omitting needsHumanReview.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2 and #3:
- A repro on HEAD 8a53505e or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place.
- A failure line from today's logs.
- For client-wire drift: the daemon file:line that emits the shape and the plugin file:line that drops or misreads it.
- For docs drift: the doc line and the code file:line.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 8a53505e or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or an emitter/consumer (or doc/code) file:line pair.
No filed row targets docs/MCP_SERVER.md, moe-vscode/**, scripts/moe-agent.* or a file an open row's plan holds, per lanes.js at hunt time. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
